purpose: Reconcile the 25 project analyses and five additional Markdown analyses with the completed source archive without opaque automatic mapping

reading_status.use: historical reasoning, failure causes, source lineage, and candidate claims were reviewed; only independently parseable completion sources were promoted to the builder

promoted_to_reproduction_sources: Block 1~6 and ending final CSV rows with explicit disk_offset/raw_old/raw_new
Logo source BIN streams and the verified RAM-to-raw reverse map/formula
Gameover original token-pair DOCX tables and the four SUB-to-D88 groups
Error message DOCX D88 and D88 저장값 columns, including the documented row-50 warning
476 KANJI VISUALTXT glyphs with explicit filename offsets
confirmed_completion_facts: Seven final D88 bundles can each be rebuilt exactly from the canonical baseline; they are independent branches, not one cumulative image.
Logo source streams account for 7,595 changed raw bytes under the verified reverse map.
KANJI source contains 476 unique 32-byte glyph slots and 7,616 source byte writes.
The Error table yields 97 source writes and 73 changed bytes on the baseline; its row-50 range/value-count inconsistency is retained as a warning.
The D88 remains a fixed-size mixed-sector image and the KANJI1 output remains a fixed-size ROM.
historical_or_partial_only: Projects 1~18 are discovery, probes, and failed or incomplete intermediate attempts.
Projects 19~22 contain useful checkpoints but rejected control-token hypotheses and incomplete integration.
Project 23 records partial repatching and glyph work, not a single complete semantic table.

Projects 24~25 and the five Markdown sources preserve unresolved mappings, discarded experiments, and conflicting completion language; those passages remain lineage evidence rather than build instructions.
